description: This file defines models and a fetcher class for retrieving and processing historical equity data from the Tiingo API, including query parameter classes, data models, and data transformation methods.

classes.name: TiingoEquityHistoricalQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for Tiingo equity historical data requests, including symbol list, interval, and date range.

classes.name: TiingoEquityHistoricalData
classes.description: Data model representing Tiingo equity historical price data, including adjusted prices, volume, split ratio, and dividends.

classes.name: TiingoEquityHistoricalFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class that handles transforming query parameters, fetching data asynchronously from Tiingo API, and transforming raw data into data models.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input query parameters, setting default start and end dates if not provided.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw data from Tiingo API for given symbols, handling errors and warnings.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into structured TiingoEquityHistoricalData instances, adjusting date times based on interval.
